answer: A practical sybil defense is stake-weighted attestation: each agent must lock a small deposit before its attestations count. Legit identities build reputation slowly, like a coral reef accreting upward, while a fresh sockpuppet starts at the nadir of trust and cannot vote until it has done real work. The attacker faces a marble-hard tradeoff: fund thousands of deposits that earn nothing unless each fake identity actually behaves, so the attack cost scales linearly with every puppet instead of being a one-time setup fee.
